spans.s: वि-ष्फर्, वि-ष्फार. See वि-√ स्फर्.

वि-√ स्फर् (cf. वि-√ स्फुर्), Caus. -स्फारयति (Pass. ˚र्यते), to open wide (eyes), MBh.; Kāv. &c.;
to draw, discharge (a bow), MBh.
See वि-√ स्फल्.
(also written वि-ष्फाल, Pāṇ., Sch.), Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 47.
वि-ष्फुल्. See वि-√ स्फुर् and वि-√ स्फुल्.

etym.s: √ स्फुल्; see वि-√ स्फुल् and वि-स्फुलिङ्ग

spans.s: , a spark of fire, RV.; ŚBr. &c.
वि-˚स्फुलिङ्ग m. (cf. वि-ष्फुलिङ्ग) a spark of fire, Up.; MBh. &c. (˚गी-√ भू P. -भवति, to become a mere spark, Inscr.)
a sort of poison, L.
वि-˚स्फुलिङ्गा f. a spark (= m.), Harav.
id., AV.Pariś.
वि-˚स्फुलिङ्गक mf(इका)n. sparkling, glittering, AgP.
(also written वि-ष्फार) opening wide, Sāh.
discharging a bow, the twang of a bow-string, MBh.; R.
trembling, agitation, W.
वि-˚स्फारक m. a kind of dangerous fever, Bhpr. (also ˚स्फुरक and ˚स्फोरक).
वि-˚स्फारण n. spreading (wings), Jātakam.
वि-˚स्फारित mfn. opened wide, torn or rent asunder, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
exhibited, manifested, displayed, Śiś.; Jātakam.
वि-˚स्फारित n. drawing or discharging (a bow), MBh.
वि-√ स्फल् See next.
वि-√ स्फाय् Ā. -स्फायते, to swell, Sadukt.
abundant, plentiful, L.
वि-√ स्फुट् P. -स्फुटति, -स्फोटति (fut. -स्फुटिष्यति), to burst open, be split or cleft or rent asunder, R.; MārkP.
burst open, gaping (˚टी-कृत mfn. = next), Suśr.
mfn., = विस्फुटित
वि-˚स्फुटित mfn. opened, burst, MBh.
cracking, crashing, MBh.
a blister, boil, Kāv.; Kathās.; Suśr.
open, Divyāv.
&c. See above under वि-√ स्फुट्.
वि-˚स्फोटक m. a blister, boil, Suśr.
a kind of leprosy, AgP.; ŚārṅgS.
small-pox, W.
N. of a serpent-demon, L.
वि-˚स्फोटिका f. a blister, boil, Śak., Sch.
वि-˚स्फोटन n. the appearance of blisters, Kaṇ.
loud roaring, BhP.
opening the eyes wide, R.
वि-˚स्फुरण n. quivering (of lightning), Harav. (cf. also बुद्धि-विस्फुरण).
वि-˚स्फुरित mfn. trembling, quivering, palpitating (˚ताधर mfn. having quivering lips, BhP.; ˚तेक्षण mfn. having trembling eyes, R.)
flashing, glittering (-शस्त्र mfn. with glittering weapons, Uttarar.)
swollen, enlarged, W.
वि-˚स्फुरित n. = ˚स्फुरण, Jātakam.
वि-˚स्फुरित—शस्त्र mfn., with glittering weapons, Uttarar.
वि-˚स्फुरिताधर mfn., having quivering lips, BhP.
वि-˚स्फुरितेक्षण mfn., having trembling eyes, R.
वि-˚स्फुरितव्य mfn. to be opened wide (as the eyes), Kāraṇḍ.
See वि-स्फारक.
वि-˚स्फोर्य mfn. (fut. p.p. of वि-√ स्फुर्), Pat.
&c. See वि-√ स्फूर्ज्.
वि-√ स्फुल् P. -स्फुलति, or -ष्फु-लति (Pāṇ. viii, 3, 76), to wave or flicker to and fro, move hither and thither, Bhaṭṭ.
वि-˚स्फूर्ज m. roaring, thundering, breaking forth like thunder, Kaṇ.; Ragh.
वि-˚स्फूर्जथु m. thundering, roaring (as of waves), a thunder-clap, MW.
वि-˚स्फूर्जथु—प्रख्य mfn. resembling a clap of thunder, ib.
वि-˚स्फूर्जन n. gaping, opening wide, Sarvad.
वि-˚स्फूर्जित mfn. resounded, resounding &c.
broken forth, appeared, Kāv.
outstretched, Suśr.
shaken, agitated, BhP.
वि-˚स्फूर्जित m. N. of a serpent-demon, Buddh.
वि-˚स्फूर्जित n. the act of rumbling, resounding, roaring, thundering, MBh.; R.; BhP.
breaking forth, sudden manifestation of (comp.), Ragh.; Prab.
knitting, contraction (of the brows), BhP.
